rows.reply: We open on Saturday at 10 am and close at 4 pm.

Yes, orders can be cancelled free of charge within 48 hours of placing them. After 48 hours a 15% restocking fee applies. Custom-made furniture cannot be cancelled once production has started, usually 5 working days after the order.

Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 7 working days after we receive the returned item. Items must be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition, and delivery charges are non-refundable.
An initial design consultation costs ₹2,500, which is fully credited against any order above ₹50,000.
In-stock items are delivered within 3 to 5 working days. We deliver across Karnataka; outside Bengaluru a delivery charge of ₹1,200 applies.

Custom orders take 4 to 6 weeks from design sign-off. We deliver across Karnataka; outside Bengaluru a delivery charge of ₹1,200 applies. Would you like to start the design process or book a showroom viewing to discuss measurements?
Yes, a delivery charge of ₹1,200 applies for locations outside Bengaluru. We deliver across Karnataka, and in-stock items arrive within 3 to 5 working days.

I can help you book a showroom viewing for Saturday morning. We have 45-minute slots available at 10 am, 11 am, and 12 pm on Saturdays (we're open 10 am–4 pm). To book, I'll need: Which Saturday — this Saturday (23 Aug) or next Saturday (30 Aug)? Preferred time slot (10 am, 11 am, or 12 pm)? Any listing or inquiry reference you have (optional, but helpful)? Want me to go into more detail?
Yes, standard installation is charged at 8% of the order value.

An initial design consultation costs ₹2,500, which is fully credited against any order above ₹50,000. Custom orders take 4 to 6 weeks from design sign-off. Would you like to book a consultation or discuss your sofa requirements?

I can't share other people's personal details — that includes any other customer's phone number, email, address or messages. It's private to them, the same way your details are private to you. Happy to help with anything on your own account though.
To check revenue, I'd need a finance system like QuickBooks, Stripe, or Razorpay to be authorised. Would you like me to help with something else using the available tools?
